title: Cross-Surface Authority Compliance — Implementation Scope
principle: Build the governance spine first — every protocol surface must route through it. Then harden each surface from highest blast-radius to lowest. No surface expansion until its tier is compliant with the spine.

phases.name: Governance Spine Hardening (Blockers Before Any Expansion)
phases.description: Fix the governance spine so it actually enforces. No surface can be compliant until the core governance pipeline works.

items.label: Fix GovernanceRuntime.should_execute_tool
items.description: Must check ToolPermission.NEVER (block), ASK (trigger approval callback), ALWAYS (allow). Consult session-specific tool permissions from agent profile config.

items.label: Add decision_id to GateDecision
items.description: Add decision_id (UUIDv7) to GateDecision model. Emit with every governance evaluation.

items.label: Emit governance decisions as evidence
items.description: GovernanceEngine.evaluate_action_legality must emit ReceiptEnvelope containing policy decision. Route through ReceiptStore for audit trail.

items.label: Align ReceiptEnvelope with evidence spine
items.description: Add authority_tier, trace_id, session_id, receipt_sha256 to ReceiptEnvelope. Replace is_authoritative boolean with authority_tier enum.

items.label: Block MCP mutation tools until governance integration
items.description: Hard-block tier-4/5 MCP tools with cryptographic refusal until governance pipeline is integrated. Replace string-presence check with HMAC enforcement. Enforce per-user auth.

items.label: Replace GitHub boolean approval with HMAC verification
items.description: Replace approval_ok boolean with HMAC-signed approval receipt verification. Check approval chain and scope before allowing live PR mutation.

items.label: Wire GitHub receipt module into mutation adapter
items.description: Call build_github_operation_receipt() from mutation adapter. Emit evidence envelope for every GitHub mutation operation.

phases.name: Surface Evidence & Content-Light Hardening
phases.description: Ensure every surface produces evidence envelopes and content-light scans. Fix cross-surface field gaps.

items.label: MCP evidence envelopes + content-light
items.description: Emit evidence envelopes with all 16 required fields for every MCP tool call. Integrate redaction.py content-light scanning into MCP response path. Add cross-surface fields to MCP models.

items.label: MCP read-only tool dispatch through governance
items.description: Wire MCP read-only tools through real governance pipeline. Verify descriptor integrity at dispatch. Add tools/call to sync handler.

items.label: ConversationRuntime surface awareness
items.description: Add surface enum to ConversationRuntime context. Enforce authority tier per-surface. Emit per-tool evidence envelopes. Detect mutation tools in batch.

items.label: Intent audit → ReceiptStore integration
items.description: Route intent audit events through ReceiptStore. Emit ReceiptEnvelope objects with surface=cockpit.

items.label: BridgeMessage authority fields
items.description: Add authority_tier, policy_decision_id, receipt_sha256 to BridgeMessage. Add governance_decision_id to bridge refusals.

items.label: Intent registry authority metadata
items.description: Add authority_tier, requires_receipt, minimum_receipt_kind to intent registries.

items.label: Projection authority context + public/private split
items.description: Add authority tier context to projection. Structural public/private split with public_sections and private_sections.

items.label: Static docs public/private classification
items.description: Add public_private_classification to site manifest documents. Reject internal_only docs from publication. Audit existing 71 governance docs.

items.label: MCP roots enforcement + sampling policy
items.description: Enforce workspace root boundaries on all MCP tool paths. Gate sampling by explicit policy.

items.label: CLI governance pre-flight + evidence
items.description: Add governance pre-flight to CLI entrypoint. Emit surface registration evidence. AgentLoop surface registration on init.

phases.name: ACP/IDE Convergence
phases.description: Harden ACP and IDE sidecar to share the governance spine.

items.label: IDE sidecar governance integration
items.description: Route IDE sidecar permission checks through governance engine and capability gate. Remove static manifest-only permission lookup.

items.label: ACP evidence envelopes
items.description: Emit evidence envelopes for every ACP edit proposal, permission request, and tool invocation.

items.label: ACP permission bypass hardening
items.description: Hard-enforce permissions at ACP layer independent of agent profile. Bypass requires explicit admin authorization with audit event.

phases.name: Hosted/Team Mode Readiness
phases.description: Enterprise admin tools and fleet orchestration governance.

items.label: Tenant admin governance
items.description: Gate tenant register/grant through governance engine. Dry-run by default. Evidence receipt per admin operation.

items.label: Fleet admin governance
items.description: Gate fleet start/stop/restart through governance engine. Evidence receipt per fleet operation.

phases.name: A2A/A2A Mutation Protocol Surfaces
phases.description: Harden A2A before it becomes operational.

items.label: A2A governance enforcement
items.description: Gate A2A task submission through governance engine. Validate trust tier before accepting tasks.

items.label: A2A cryptographic attestation
items.description: Add HMAC-signed attestation fields to A2A models. Verify attestation before state transitions.

items.label: A2A delegation receipt production
items.description: Produce delegation receipts for every A2A task submission.

items.label: A2A trust tier enforcement
items.description: Enforce multi-tier trust model. Gate task submission on trust boundary.

phases.name: Polish & Procurement Evidence
phases.description: GitHub Trust Spine formalization and cross-surface audit completeness.

items.label: GitHub Trust Spine formalization
items.description: Implement canonical GitHub Trust Spine with tiered trust levels, cryptographic attestation chain, and governance spine integration.

items.label: Gate preflight governance-dir writes
items.description: Add governance approval for scripts writing to docs/json/governance/.

do_not_overrun_guards: Do not implement MCP mutation tools before cryptographic approval receipts exist
Do not make A2A operational before trust tiers and attestation are enforced
Do not expose tenant/fleet admin without governance gating
Do not expand any protocol surface before its P0/P1 blockers are resolved
Do not add dependencies during compliance hardening (pure architecture fixes only)
Do not bypass the evidence spine — every fix must emit receipts
Do not wire MCP directly to AgentLoop without content-light scanning and evidence envelope emission
Do not remove hard-blocks on MCP tier-4/5 until HMAC enforcement is proven
